hook.name: AegisHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that applies dynamic LP fees via an external DynamicFeeManager, charges a configurable hook fee on each swap (deducted from the input token using BeforeSwapDelta/afterSwap delta), records price observations via an OracleManager, integrates with a LimitOrderManager, and periodically reinvests accumulated hook fees into full-range LP positions through AegisEngine.
